scope: One bounded operational SPY long-to-flat trial, separate fresh reconciliation and completed-trial recovery
credentials: Existing private paper environment, loaded only into authorized process; no credential values or account identifiers retained here

fresh_reconciliation.scope: Separate read-only SDK process, five actual paper GET requests

completed_trial_recovery.meaning: A fresh process adopted the same two completed identities without duplicate submission. This did not inject a broker outage or process crash.

independent_source_review.result: no unresolved supported high or medium findings
independent_source_review.resolved_finding: Preserve known accepted orders through lookup visibility gaps, cancel by known ID, and require terminal confirmation before exit.

limitations: Operational smoke acceptance, not an accepted profitable strategy or continuous service.
No native partial-fill, cancellation, rejection, disconnect or crash was induced; those paths currently have synthetic test evidence.
Limit exits can remain unfilled; gross realized-loss limits do not bound fees or unrealized gap loss.
The fresh cash match is observed for this short trial and is not a general fees model.
The account exposes 200 API calls/minute; Elite 1000/minute and high-throughput execution are unqualified.
Native recovery covered an already completed trial, not an uncertain in-flight order.
IBKR and live trading remain separate.
